description: The FREE fund door: a signed, non-custodial statement that you will put $X behind this packet. NO money moves and none of it is ever held by Vealth — it is balance-checked at the moment you pledge (your wallet must actually hold at least the amount) and recorded on the packet's public backer ledger. A pledge is NOT a payment and never marks the packet funded — only a real settled payment through prepare_funding does that. Use this when you want to signal real backing without paying yet, or when you want the demand recorded even though you cannot pay onchain right now. A pledge cannot exceed the packet's own posted wage. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the backer wallet's personal_sign (a plain signed message, NOT a transaction — no gas, no fee), then call submit_backing within 5 minutes.

amountUsd.description: How much you pledge to back this packet with, in USD. Cannot exceed the packet's posted wage.

backerKind.description: Self-declared attribution, same as voterKind. Defaults to human if omitted.

backerWallet.description: The 0x… address that will sign and own this pledge. Must hold at least amountUsd for it to verify.

reason.description: Optional, up to 280 characters, shown on the public backer ledger.

name: prepare_backing
title: Pledge to back a packet — free, no payment (step 1 of 2)
